purpose: Alternative descriptions of potentially relevant source records, not additional scoring requirements. Retrieve supporting, contradictory and proposed evidence; assessment determines what it establishes.

AIQIF-C1.1.F1.assertion: An approved institutional plan identifies a digital or AI priority.
AIQIF-C1.1.F1.query: Approved strategic plan, institutional development plan, governing council resolution or digital transformation roadmap listing digital or artificial intelligence priorities and effective dates.

AIQIF-C1.1.F2.assertion: A responsible owner is assigned to that priority.
AIQIF-C1.1.F2.query: Strategic plan responsibility matrix, appointment order, named coordinator or committee terms of reference assigning ownership of the digital priority.

AIQIF-C1.1.A1.assertion: Delivery records demonstrate an AI initiative operating in an identified institutional function.
AIQIF-C1.1.A1.query: AI initiative implementation report, service deployment register, operating logs, delivery dates and institutional department using the system; distinguish proposed, active and discontinued status.

AIQIF-C1.1.A2.assertion: A portfolio review records a decision about an AI initiative.
AIQIF-C1.1.A2.query: AI project portfolio meeting minutes, project review register, continuation, revision or closure decision and assigned action.

AIQIF-C1.1.O1.assertion: A completed portfolio review compares a measured result with its stated objective.
AIQIF-C1.1.O1.query: Completed AI project portfolio evaluation, original objective, target, measured delivery result and comparison recorded in review minutes.

AIQIF-C1.1.O2.assertion: A subsequent record evaluates the effect of a portfolio decision.
AIQIF-C1.1.O2.query: Follow-up portfolio review after a project funding, scope, continuation or closure decision, with subsequent results and effects of the decision.

AIQIF-C1.2.F1.assertion: An institutional body has authority over relevant digital or AI decisions.
AIQIF-C1.2.F1.query: Governing body, academic council, IT committee or digital governance charter, constitution, delegated decision authority and terms of reference.

AIQIF-C1.2.F2.assertion: An escalation route is defined for those decisions.
AIQIF-C1.2.F2.query: Digital governance escalation procedure, approval hierarchy, issue referral route, delegated limits and responsible decision body.

AIQIF-C1.2.A1.assertion: A dated governance decision concerns an actual AI use.
AIQIF-C1.2.A1.query: Dated committee minutes or approval register deciding an actual artificial intelligence deployment, use case or operational exception.

AIQIF-C1.2.A2.assertion: An assigned governance action has a recorded follow-up.
AIQIF-C1.2.A2.query: Governance action tracker linking an AI decision, accountable owner, due date, follow-up and recorded disposition.

AIQIF-C1.2.O1.assertion: A review evaluates governance performance using an identified incident or delivery result.
AIQIF-C1.2.O1.query: Governance effectiveness review using an incident, delayed delivery or actual operational result to assess decision performance.

AIQIF-C1.2.O2.assertion: A follow-up checks implementation of a revised governance rule.
AIQIF-C1.2.O2.query: Revised governance procedure and later compliance check, implementation follow-up, sampled decisions or audit findings after the revision.

AIQIF-C1.3.F1.assertion: A resource commitment supports relevant computing, teaching or innovation capacity.
AIQIF-C1.3.F1.query: Budget sanction, annual accounts, audited financial statement, equipment purchase, grant allocation or committed staff time supporting computing, teaching, laboratories or innovation.

AIQIF-C1.3.F2.assertion: An allocation decision identifies the intended beneficiary group or function.
AIQIF-C1.3.F2.query: Allocation order, budget note or resource sanction naming beneficiary department, student group, staff group or supported institutional function.

AIQIF-C1.3.A1.assertion: A review compares committed resources with an identified delivery need.
AIQIF-C1.3.A1.query: Resource needs assessment comparing sanctioned funds, equipment or staffing with documented project delivery requirements.

AIQIF-C1.3.A2.assertion: A resource decision responds to a documented capacity shortfall.
AIQIF-C1.3.A2.query: Capacity shortfall report, unmet resource request, revised budget, additional allocation or reallocation decision responding to the identified gap.

AIQIF-C1.3.O1.assertion: A completed review compares a stated resource cost with a measured benefit or capacity result.
AIQIF-C1.3.O1.query: Completed cost-benefit or capacity review linking expenditure to measured service, equipment, staffing or teaching capacity results.

AIQIF-C1.3.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates the effect of a resource allocation change.
AIQIF-C1.3.O2.query: Post-allocation review showing the effect of a changed budget, staffing or equipment decision on subsequent capacity or delivery.

AIQIF-C1.4.F1.assertion: A process exists for introducing a digital service or teaching tool.
AIQIF-C1.4.F1.query: Digital service rollout procedure, software introduction process, teaching tool pilot, onboarding plan and implementation approvals.

AIQIF-C1.4.F2.assertion: Users have an identified support contact for that service or tool.
AIQIF-C1.4.F2.query: Helpdesk contact, service desk, support coordinator or user guidance naming the contact for a digital service or teaching tool.

AIQIF-C1.4.A1.assertion: Usage records demonstrate repeated use within an identified deployment scope.
AIQIF-C1.4.A1.query: Dated user activity logs, repeated service transactions, attendance or usage statistics for an identified deployed digital tool and user group.

AIQIF-C1.4.A2.assertion: A support action responds to a documented adoption barrier.
AIQIF-C1.4.A2.query: Adoption barrier, user support ticket, accessibility complaint or training need linked to a corrective support response.

AIQIF-C1.4.O1.assertion: A completed review compares adoption with an explicit target.
AIQIF-C1.4.O1.query: Completed adoption review comparing active users, participation or repeated usage with a stated rollout target.

AIQIF-C1.4.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates an adoption or user-experience change.
AIQIF-C1.4.O2.query: User experience or adoption follow-up after a support, onboarding or service change, including subsequent usage or feedback results.

AIQIF-C2.1.F1.assertion: Effective institutional guidance explicitly addresses AI use.
AIQIF-C2.1.F1.query: Effective generative AI policy, artificial intelligence acceptable-use guidance, approval date, applicability and institutional policy notice.

AIQIF-C2.1.F2.assertion: The guidance defines a restriction on unsafe or inappropriate AI use.
AIQIF-C2.1.F2.query: AI use policy clauses on prohibited uses, unsafe outputs, academic misconduct, confidentiality restrictions or mandatory human checks.

AIQIF-C2.1.A1.assertion: A deployment or onboarding check applies an AI policy requirement.
AIQIF-C2.1.A1.query: AI deployment approval checklist, staff onboarding record or implementation check applying a specific responsible-use policy clause.

AIQIF-C2.1.A2.assertion: A sampled-use review records the disposition of a policy exception.
AIQIF-C2.1.A2.query: Sampled AI use audit, exception register, waiver decision, policy violation review and recorded disposition.

AIQIF-C2.1.O1.assertion: A policy review evaluates an identified incident or assurance finding.
AIQIF-C2.1.O1.query: Responsible AI policy review minutes considering an actual incident, compliance audit or assurance finding.

AIQIF-C2.1.O2.assertion: A follow-up tests the effect of a revised responsible-use control.
AIQIF-C2.1.O2.query: Follow-up assurance test, sampled compliance results or incident review after a responsible-use policy control was changed.

AIQIF-C2.2.F1.assertion: Responsibility for personal or sensitive institutional data is assigned.
AIQIF-C2.2.F1.query: Data protection responsibility order, privacy officer appointment, information ownership register or custodian assignment for personal or sensitive records.

AIQIF-C2.2.F2.assertion: An access-control procedure covers the relevant information system.
AIQIF-C2.2.F2.query: Information system access policy, role permissions, account authorization, access approval and revocation procedure.

AIQIF-C2.2.A1.assertion: A risk assessment covers an identified deployed use.
AIQIF-C2.2.A1.query: Documented risk assessment for a deployed system or AI use, identifying data exposure, security threats, likelihood and controls.

AIQIF-C2.2.A2.assertion: A recorded risk decision responds to an identified access or supplier change.
AIQIF-C2.2.A2.query: Access change or supplier change risk review, approval decision, mitigation action and recorded acceptance or rejection.

AIQIF-C2.2.O1.assertion: A completed risk review compares exposure with a stated risk criterion.
AIQIF-C2.2.O1.query: Completed risk review comparing assessed exposure or residual risk with an explicit tolerance, threshold or risk criterion.

AIQIF-C2.2.O2.assertion: A follow-up tests the effectiveness of an implemented remediation.
AIQIF-C2.2.O2.query: Remediation verification, access control retest, supplier control check or privacy risk follow-up measuring whether the implemented fix worked.

AIQIF-C2.3.F1.assertion: An inventory identifies the AI services in use within the assessed scope.
AIQIF-C2.3.F1.query: AI service inventory, model register or application catalogue listing artificial intelligence systems actually in use and their deployment scope.

AIQIF-C2.3.F2.assertion: A responsible owner is assigned to each inventoried service.
AIQIF-C2.3.F2.query: AI service register assigning a responsible owner, system steward or accountable department to each deployed service.

AIQIF-C2.3.A1.assertion: An evaluation record concerns an actual AI service release or change.
AIQIF-C2.3.A1.query: AI model release evaluation, version approval, change acceptance test or deployment assessment for an actual service update.

AIQIF-C2.3.A2.assertion: A change record identifies data provenance for that service.
AIQIF-C2.3.A2.query: AI service change log recording dataset origin, data lineage, collection source, permitted use or provenance of the changed data.

AIQIF-C2.3.O1.assertion: A monitored release compares operational behaviour with a stated evaluation criterion.
AIQIF-C2.3.O1.query: Model monitoring report comparing deployed AI behaviour, error rate or drift with a stated release evaluation threshold.

AIQIF-C2.3.O2.assertion: A rollback or retirement exercise records its observed result.
AIQIF-C2.3.O2.query: AI service rollback drill, model retirement exercise, withdrawal record or recovery test documenting what actually happened.

AIQIF-C2.4.F1.assertion: A human intervention route is defined for an identified consequential AI use.
AIQIF-C2.4.F1.query: Consequential AI decision workflow defining human approval, override, suspension or intervention authority for an identified use.

AIQIF-C2.4.F2.assertion: Affected users have an error or appeal reporting route for that use.
AIQIF-C2.4.F2.query: AI decision appeal procedure, complaint form, error reporting channel and guidance available to affected users.

AIQIF-C2.4.A1.assertion: A record demonstrates human oversight of an actual consequential AI use.
AIQIF-C2.4.A1.query: Actual AI decision review log, human intervention record, override or sign-off for a consequential use case.

AIQIF-C2.4.A2.assertion: An assurance test examines a specified failure or fairness risk in that use.
AIQIF-C2.4.A2.query: AI assurance test specifying a failure mode, subgroup fairness risk, test procedure and observed result for the deployed use.

AIQIF-C2.4.O1.assertion: A reviewer separate from the delivery decision evaluates an identified harm or oversight result.
AIQIF-C2.4.O1.query: Independent ethics, assurance or oversight review evaluating a specific harm, incident or human review outcome.

AIQIF-C2.4.O2.assertion: A follow-up tests the effect of an oversight change.
AIQIF-C2.4.O2.query: Follow-up oversight evaluation after changing an intervention, appeal or approval process, with observed effects.

AIQIF-C3.1.F1.assertion: An approved syllabus includes substantive AI or ML content.
AIQIF-C3.1.F1.query: Approved course syllabus or curriculum regulation containing artificial intelligence, machine learning, neural networks or substantive AI topics.

AIQIF-C3.1.F2.assertion: An explicit learning objective addresses that AI or ML content.
AIQIF-C3.1.F2.query: Course learning objectives or outcomes explicitly addressing the AI or machine learning content in the approved syllabus.

AIQIF-C3.1.A1.assertion: Teaching records demonstrate delivery of substantive AI content to an identified programme group.
AIQIF-C3.1.A1.query: Teaching diary, timetable, lesson plan, class delivery record or course completion report showing AI content taught to a named programme cohort.

AIQIF-C3.1.A2.assertion: Assessed student work demonstrates attainment against an explicit AI learning criterion.
AIQIF-C3.1.A2.query: Assessed student AI assignments, examinations, marking rubrics, learning outcome results and criterion-based attainment.

AIQIF-C3.1.O1.assertion: A completed course review compares AI learning attainment with a stated objective.
AIQIF-C3.1.O1.query: Completed course review comparing measured AI learning outcome attainment with the course learning objective.

AIQIF-C3.1.O2.assertion: A subsequent assessment evaluates the effect of a curriculum revision.
AIQIF-C3.1.O2.query: Curriculum revision record and later comparable assessment results evaluating the effect of changed AI content or teaching.

AIQIF-C3.2.F1.assertion: An AI literacy learning offer is defined.
AIQIF-C3.2.F1.query: AI literacy course offer, introductory workshop outline, learning module, scope and defined educational content.

AIQIF-C3.2.F2.assertion: A delivery route makes that offer available to an identified learner group.
AIQIF-C3.2.F2.query: AI literacy registration notice, enrolment route, learning platform access or programme availability for a named learner group.

AIQIF-C3.2.A1.assertion: Delivery records demonstrate an AI literacy activity for an identified discipline.
AIQIF-C3.2.A1.query: AI literacy workshop delivery report, class attendance, teaching record and identified academic discipline.

AIQIF-C3.2.A2.assertion: A support response addresses a documented discipline-specific access or learning gap.
AIQIF-C3.2.A2.query: Discipline-specific AI literacy access or learning gap, request for help, adapted provision or targeted support action.

AIQIF-C3.2.O1.assertion: An assessment reports AI literacy attainment for an identified discipline.
AIQIF-C3.2.O1.query: AI literacy assessment results, tested knowledge or competencies and attainment for a named discipline.

AIQIF-C3.2.O2.assertion: A follow-up assessment evaluates the effect of targeted literacy support.
AIQIF-C3.2.O2.query: Follow-up AI literacy assessment after discipline-specific tutoring, access support or learning materials changed.

AIQIF-C3.3.F1.assertion: A course design specifies an AI-supported learning or feedback activity.
AIQIF-C3.3.F1.query: Course design or lesson plan specifying an AI-supported teaching, learning, assessment feedback or tutoring activity.

AIQIF-C3.3.F2.assertion: Learner instructions define acceptable AI use for that activity.
AIQIF-C3.3.F2.query: Assignment brief, learner instructions or acceptable-use guidance defining permitted AI use for that course activity.

AIQIF-C3.3.A1.assertion: Course records demonstrate repeated use of an identified AI-supported learning activity.
AIQIF-C3.3.A1.query: Course logs, student submissions or teaching records showing repeated delivery of the specified AI-supported learning activity.

AIQIF-C3.3.A2.assertion: An assessment check evaluates inappropriate dependence on AI in that activity.
AIQIF-C3.3.A2.query: Assessment integrity check, independent task, oral examination or review of student dependence on AI-generated work.

AIQIF-C3.3.O1.assertion: A completed evaluation compares learning or feedback results with a stated baseline.
AIQIF-C3.3.O1.query: Completed comparison of AI-supported learning or feedback results against a stated prior or comparison baseline.

AIQIF-C3.3.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates the effect of a change to the AI-supported learning design.
AIQIF-C3.3.O2.query: Follow-up course evaluation after changing an AI-supported activity or feedback design, with subsequent learning results.

AIQIF-C3.4.F1.assertion: A student project or lab route includes substantive AI work.
AIQIF-C3.4.F1.query: Student project brief, practical laboratory module or project route involving implementation of substantive artificial intelligence work.

AIQIF-C3.4.F2.assertion: A mentoring route is provided for that work.
AIQIF-C3.4.F2.query: Project mentor allocation, supervision schedule, laboratory support or faculty mentoring route for student AI work.

AIQIF-C3.4.A1.assertion: Assessed project work demonstrates an implemented AI application for an identified student group.
AIQIF-C3.4.A1.query: Assessed AI project report, working prototype, implemented application, evaluation rubric and identified student group.

AIQIF-C3.4.A2.assertion: A moderation record checks individual contribution to that work.
AIQIF-C3.4.A2.query: Individual project contribution record, moderation minutes, viva assessment or contribution verification within group AI work.

AIQIF-C3.4.O1.assertion: A completed project review evaluates work against an explicit capability criterion.
AIQIF-C3.4.O1.query: Completed AI project evaluation against an explicit technical, practical or learning capability criterion.

AIQIF-C3.4.O2.assertion: Later work is evaluated against a comparable criterion after a mentoring or design change.
AIQIF-C3.4.O2.query: Later project assessments using a comparable criterion after a mentoring, laboratory or project design change.

AIQIF-C4.1.F1.assertion: An AI-focused faculty learning activity has defined content.
AIQIF-C4.1.F1.query: Faculty development programme (FDP), AI or machine learning workshop outline, learning materials and defined artificial intelligence content.

AIQIF-C4.1.F2.assertion: Participation in an AI-focused learning activity is documented for an identified faculty group.
AIQIF-C4.1.F2.query: Faculty AI or machine learning training attendance, FDP participant register, completion certificates and identified department or faculty group.

AIQIF-C4.1.A1.assertion: An assessment demonstrates AI literacy for an identified faculty group.
AIQIF-C4.1.A1.query: Faculty AI literacy test, assessed exercise, competency demonstration and results for a named faculty group.

AIQIF-C4.1.A2.assertion: A support response addresses a documented faculty literacy gap.
AIQIF-C4.1.A2.query: Faculty AI literacy assessment gap linked to remedial training, mentoring or a targeted support action.

AIQIF-C4.1.O1.assertion: A completed assessment compares faculty literacy with a stated competency criterion.
AIQIF-C4.1.O1.query: Completed faculty AI competency assessment comparing results with a defined literacy standard or criterion.

AIQIF-C4.1.O2.assertion: A follow-up assessment evaluates the effect of a faculty learning revision.
AIQIF-C4.1.O2.query: Follow-up faculty AI literacy assessment after revision of a faculty development programme or learning materials.

AIQIF-C4.2.F1.assertion: A faculty AI learning offer targets an identified academic role.
AIQIF-C4.2.F1.query: Faculty AI learning pathway for a specified teaching, research, assessment or academic administration role.

AIQIF-C4.2.F2.assertion: A practice task develops a specific AI-related academic skill for that role.
AIQIF-C4.2.F2.query: Role-specific faculty practice exercise applying AI to lesson design, assessment, research or another named academic skill.

AIQIF-C4.2.A1.assertion: An assessed role-relevant task demonstrates a faculty AI skill.
AIQIF-C4.2.A1.query: Assessed faculty AI task, role-relevant work product, marking criterion and demonstrated practical skill.

AIQIF-C4.2.A2.assertion: A support action addresses a documented role-specific skill gap.
AIQIF-C4.2.A2.query: Role-specific faculty skill gap, assessment feedback and targeted mentoring or support response.

AIQIF-C4.2.O1.assertion: An academic work sample demonstrates application of the assessed skill.
AIQIF-C4.2.O1.query: Actual academic work sample applying a previously assessed AI skill in teaching, assessment or research practice.

AIQIF-C4.2.O2.assertion: A subsequent task evaluation tests the effect of a role-pathway revision.
AIQIF-C4.2.O2.query: Subsequent role-specific task assessment after a faculty AI learning pathway was revised.

AIQIF-C4.3.F1.assertion: A faculty work record demonstrates AI use in an academic task.
AIQIF-C4.3.F1.query: Faculty work sample, teaching record, research workflow or academic task documenting actual AI tool use.

AIQIF-C4.3.F2.assertion: A human review step is defined for the AI-supported task.
AIQIF-C4.3.F2.query: Academic AI workflow defining human checking, verification, editorial review or approval of AI-supported work.

AIQIF-C4.3.A1.assertion: Work samples demonstrate repeated AI use in an identified faculty practice.
AIQIF-C4.3.A1.query: Dated faculty work samples or logs demonstrating repeated AI use in a specified teaching or research practice.

AIQIF-C4.3.A2.assertion: A quality check evaluates the AI-supported academic work.
AIQIF-C4.3.A2.query: Quality assurance check, accuracy review, moderation or validation of actual AI-supported academic work.

AIQIF-C4.3.O1.assertion: A completed evaluation compares an academic quality, time or research result with a stated baseline.
AIQIF-C4.3.O1.query: Completed comparison of academic quality, task time or research output with a stated baseline for AI-supported practice.

AIQIF-C4.3.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates a practice change responding to an identified failure.
AIQIF-C4.3.O2.query: Follow-up evaluation after a practice change responding to an AI-related academic error or failure.

AIQIF-C4.4.F1.assertion: A digital or workflow learning offer targets an identified non-teaching staff role.
AIQIF-C4.4.F1.query: Non-teaching staff training offer, administrative workflow workshop, ERP or MIS learning programme and targeted staff role.

AIQIF-C4.4.F2.assertion: A support route is available to staff applying that learning.
AIQIF-C4.4.F2.query: Staff helpdesk, training support contact, workflow guidance or mentoring route available after digital skills training.

AIQIF-C4.4.A1.assertion: An assessed task demonstrates a relevant digital or AI skill for an identified staff role.
AIQIF-C4.4.A1.query: Assessed administrative staff task demonstrating a relevant digital, workflow or AI skill for a named role.

AIQIF-C4.4.A2.assertion: A support action addresses a documented staff workflow error.
AIQIF-C4.4.A2.query: Documented staff workflow error, support request, troubleshooting record and corrective assistance.

AIQIF-C4.4.O1.assertion: A completed evaluation compares staff task performance with a stated role criterion.
AIQIF-C4.4.O1.query: Completed evaluation comparing staff task accuracy, completion or performance with a defined role standard.

AIQIF-C4.4.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates the effect of a staff training or support change.
AIQIF-C4.4.O2.query: Follow-up staff task evaluation after changing training, workflow guidance or support arrangements.

AIQIF-C5.1.F1.assertion: An AI literacy offer is accessible to an identified student group.
AIQIF-C5.1.F1.query: Student AI literacy course offer, registration, access arrangements or learning materials available to a named student group.

AIQIF-C5.1.F2.assertion: A learning objective defines what that offer intends students to learn.
AIQIF-C5.1.F2.query: Explicit student AI literacy learning objectives or intended competencies in the course or workshop outline.

AIQIF-C5.1.A1.assertion: Delivery records demonstrate AI literacy provision to an identified student cohort.
AIQIF-C5.1.A1.query: AI literacy teaching records, attendance, enrolment and completed delivery for an identified student cohort.

AIQIF-C5.1.A2.assertion: A support response addresses a documented participation or attainment gap.
AIQIF-C5.1.A2.query: Student AI literacy participation or attainment gap linked to outreach, tutoring, access assistance or another support response.

AIQIF-C5.1.O1.assertion: An assessment reports student AI literacy attainment against an explicit criterion.
AIQIF-C5.1.O1.query: Student AI literacy assessment results compared with an explicit knowledge or competency criterion.

AIQIF-C5.1.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates the effect of a change addressing an access or learning gap.
AIQIF-C5.1.O2.query: Follow-up results after changing AI literacy provision to address a student access, participation or learning gap.

AIQIF-C5.2.F1.assertion: An advanced AI or ML skills pathway is defined for an identified student group.
AIQIF-C5.2.F1.query: Advanced AI or machine learning specialization, skills track or role-specific pathway for an identified student group.

AIQIF-C5.2.F2.assertion: The pathway includes a practical assessment task.
AIQIF-C5.2.F2.query: Advanced AI pathway practical examination, programming assignment, model-building task or applied assessment brief.

AIQIF-C5.2.A1.assertion: Student work demonstrates an advanced or role-specific AI skill against an explicit criterion.
AIQIF-C5.2.A1.query: Assessed student work demonstrating an advanced or role-specific AI skill against a defined performance rubric.

AIQIF-C5.2.A2.assertion: A delivery change responds to identified employer or disciplinary feedback.
AIQIF-C5.2.A2.query: Employer or discipline feedback linked to a change in an advanced AI skills pathway or its delivery.

AIQIF-C5.2.O1.assertion: A completed pathway review evaluates a relevant skill or progression result.
AIQIF-C5.2.O1.query: Completed advanced AI pathway review evaluating measured skill attainment or learner progression.

AIQIF-C5.2.O2.assertion: A subsequent task evaluation tests the effect of a pathway revision.
AIQIF-C5.2.O2.query: Subsequent practical assessment results after an advanced AI or role-specific skills pathway revision.

AIQIF-C5.3.F1.assertion: An AI project or portfolio opportunity is available to an identified student group.
AIQIF-C5.3.F1.query: AI student project, portfolio or applied practice opportunity and the group eligible to participate.

AIQIF-C5.3.F2.assertion: An evaluation criterion addresses individual contribution to the project or portfolio.
AIQIF-C5.3.F2.query: AI project or portfolio marking rubric specifying how individual student contributions are evaluated.

AIQIF-C5.3.A1.assertion: A reviewed portfolio identifies the student's substantive AI contribution.
AIQIF-C5.3.A1.query: Reviewed AI portfolio, contribution statement, code or project evidence identifying the individual student contribution.

AIQIF-C5.3.A2.assertion: A moderation record evaluates a participating student's project or portfolio.
AIQIF-C5.3.A2.query: Project moderation, viva, portfolio assessment or reviewer record evaluating an individual participant.

AIQIF-C5.3.O1.assertion: A completed evaluation assesses AI work quality or real-user value against an explicit criterion.
AIQIF-C5.3.O1.query: Completed evaluation of AI project quality or value to actual users against a stated criterion.

AIQIF-C5.3.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates the effect of a project or mentoring change.
AIQIF-C5.3.O2.query: Follow-up AI project or portfolio evaluation after changing project design, supervision or mentoring.

AIQIF-C5.4.F1.assertion: An AI-relevant internship or career opportunity is documented.
AIQIF-C5.4.F1.query: AI-relevant internship advertisement, employer role description, career opportunity or placement notice.

AIQIF-C5.4.F2.assertion: An eligibility rule identifies who can access the opportunity.
AIQIF-C5.4.F2.query: Internship or career opportunity eligibility rules, access conditions and identified eligible student group.

AIQIF-C5.4.A1.assertion: A verified record demonstrates participation in an AI-relevant internship or career opportunity.
AIQIF-C5.4.A1.query: Verified internship completion, employer confirmation, placement or participation record for an AI-relevant opportunity.

AIQIF-C5.4.A2.assertion: A cohort register identifies the denominator used to interpret participation or progression.
AIQIF-C5.4.A2.query: Cohort register listing eligible students, participants, nonparticipants and the denominator for career progression statistics.

AIQIF-C5.4.O1.assertion: A completed review compares a verified AI-related career result with a stated target.
AIQIF-C5.4.O1.query: Completed career review comparing verified AI-related internship, placement or progression results with a stated target.

AIQIF-C5.4.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates the effect of a career-pathway change.
AIQIF-C5.4.O2.query: Follow-up career outcome review after a change to internship access, support or an AI career pathway.

AIQIF-C6.1.F1.assertion: Relevant learners or researchers have access to computing resources.
AIQIF-C6.1.F1.query: Computer centre, desktop workstations, ICT facilities, computing laboratory, library computers, server access, internet facilities and learner or researcher access arrangements.

AIQIF-C6.1.F2.assertion: Resource specifications support one explicitly stated introductory AI workload.
AIQIF-C6.1.F2.query: Computing hardware and software specifications, memory, processor, accelerator or cloud resources matched to one stated introductory AI workload.

AIQIF-C6.1.A1.assertion: Usage records show relevant computing capacity serving an identified user group.
AIQIF-C6.1.A1.query: Computer laboratory logs, resource bookings, user accounts or capacity usage statistics identifying the served learner or research group.

AIQIF-C6.1.A2.assertion: A support response addresses a documented capacity or access failure.
AIQIF-C6.1.A2.query: Computing access failure, capacity shortage, helpdesk ticket, outage or resource support response.

AIQIF-C6.1.O1.assertion: A completed review compares service performance with a stated capacity or availability target.
AIQIF-C6.1.O1.query: Completed computing service review comparing measured capacity, availability or performance with an explicit service target.

AIQIF-C6.1.O2.assertion: A continuity exercise records recovery performance for that environment.
AIQIF-C6.1.O2.query: Computing continuity drill, backup restoration or disaster recovery exercise recording achieved recovery time and service restoration.

AIQIF-C6.2.F1.assertion: A register identifies relevant institutional datasets or systems.
AIQIF-C6.2.F1.query: Institutional dataset register, information system inventory, database catalogue or list of relevant data assets.

AIQIF-C6.2.F2.assertion: A responsible data custodian is assigned to the identified assets.
AIQIF-C6.2.F2.query: Data custodian, information owner or responsible department assigned to the registered institutional datasets or systems.

AIQIF-C6.2.A1.assertion: A data-quality check operates for an identified AI use or preparation activity.
AIQIF-C6.2.A1.query: Data validation, completeness or quality checks performed for an identified AI application or preparation activity.

AIQIF-C6.2.A2.assertion: A tracked data-quality issue has a recorded disposition.
AIQIF-C6.2.A2.query: Data-quality issue tracker, error report, remediation action and recorded resolution, acceptance or rejection.

AIQIF-C6.2.O1.assertion: A completed review compares data quality with a stated fitness criterion.
AIQIF-C6.2.O1.query: Completed dataset quality review comparing measured quality with a defined fitness-for-use criterion.

AIQIF-C6.2.O2.assertion: A follow-up measures the effect of a data-quality change on downstream work.
AIQIF-C6.2.O2.query: Follow-up measurement of downstream effects after a data cleaning, validation or data-quality process change.

AIQIF-C6.3.F1.assertion: Responsibility for security of the relevant computing environment is assigned.
AIQIF-C6.3.F1.query: IT security responsibility assignment, system security officer, administrator role or accountability for the relevant computing environment.

AIQIF-C6.3.F2.assertion: A recovery procedure covers that environment.
AIQIF-C6.3.F2.query: Backup, restoration, incident recovery or business continuity procedure for that computing environment.

AIQIF-C6.3.A1.assertion: A security test examines an identified AI-related threat in the assessed environment.
AIQIF-C6.3.A1.query: Security assessment or penetration test addressing a specified AI-related threat in the deployed environment.

AIQIF-C6.3.A2.assertion: An incident or exercise record demonstrates a response action.
AIQIF-C6.3.A2.query: Security incident response log or exercise record documenting an actual containment, escalation or recovery action.

AIQIF-C6.3.O1.assertion: A completed security review compares remediation or recovery performance with a stated criterion.
AIQIF-C6.3.O1.query: Completed security review comparing remediation or recovery results with an explicit security or service criterion.

AIQIF-C6.3.O2.assertion: A follow-up test evaluates a control change responding to a documented threat.
AIQIF-C6.3.O2.query: Follow-up security test after a control was changed in response to an identified threat or vulnerability.

AIQIF-C6.4.F1.assertion: An environment supports one specified introductory AI learning activity.
AIQIF-C6.4.F1.query: Laboratory or digital learning environment specifications matched to a named introductory AI learning activity.

AIQIF-C6.4.F2.assertion: Learners have a defined access route to that environment.
AIQIF-C6.4.F2.query: Learner laboratory access rules, booking process, platform enrolment or permissions for that AI learning environment.

AIQIF-C6.4.A1.assertion: Usage records demonstrate learner access to an identified AI learning environment.
AIQIF-C6.4.A1.query: Laboratory attendance, platform activity, bookings or access logs identifying students using the AI learning environment.

AIQIF-C6.4.A2.assertion: A support response addresses a documented accessibility or capacity issue.
AIQIF-C6.4.A2.query: Accessibility complaint, assistive access issue, capacity shortage or learner support response for the learning environment.

AIQIF-C6.4.O1.assertion: A completed review compares learner access with a stated service or equity criterion.
AIQIF-C6.4.O1.query: Completed learning environment access review comparing service or equity results with a stated criterion.

AIQIF-C6.4.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates the effect of an environment improvement.
AIQIF-C6.4.O2.query: Follow-up access or learner service evaluation after an accessibility, laboratory or digital environment improvement.

AIQIF-C7.1.F1.assertion: An AI research or applied-inquiry project has a defined objective.
AIQIF-C7.1.F1.query: AI research proposal or applied-inquiry project brief specifying its research question, application objective or intended output.

AIQIF-C7.1.F2.assertion: A responsible lead is assigned to the project.
AIQIF-C7.1.F2.query: Principal investigator appointment, project lead assignment or responsibility record for the AI research project.

AIQIF-C7.1.A1.assertion: An active AI research or applied-inquiry project has a reviewed work output.
AIQIF-C7.1.A1.query: Active AI research project progress report and reviewed publication, prototype, dataset, software or other work output.

AIQIF-C7.1.A2.assertion: A progress review records a decision about that project.
AIQIF-C7.1.A2.query: AI research progress review minutes recording a continuation, revision, resource or closure decision.

AIQIF-C7.1.O1.assertion: A completed review evaluates inquiry output quality or application against a stated objective.
AIQIF-C7.1.O1.query: Completed AI inquiry review evaluating output quality or application against the original research objective.

AIQIF-C7.1.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates the effect of an agenda or resource change.
AIQIF-C7.1.O2.query: Follow-up research review after changing the agenda, project resources or research priorities.

AIQIF-C7.2.F1.assertion: An AI centre or distributed innovation function has a defined remit.
AIQIF-C7.2.F1.query: AI centre, distributed innovation unit or institutional innovation function charter defining remit and responsibilities.

AIQIF-C7.2.F2.assertion: A project or mentoring service is available through that function.
AIQIF-C7.2.F2.query: AI project assistance, mentoring, consultation or innovation service offer available through the named function.

AIQIF-C7.2.A1.assertion: A service record demonstrates an AI project or mentoring engagement.
AIQIF-C7.2.A1.query: Service register, mentoring log or engagement report demonstrating actual assistance to an AI project.

AIQIF-C7.2.A2.assertion: A service review records a decision responding to use or delivery evidence.
AIQIF-C7.2.A2.query: Innovation or mentoring service review recording a decision based on usage, delivery or project evidence.

AIQIF-C7.2.O1.assertion: A completed review evaluates an output or institutional benefit against the function's objective.
AIQIF-C7.2.O1.query: Completed review comparing an AI innovation function output or institutional benefit with its stated objective.

AIQIF-C7.2.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates the effect of a service change.
AIQIF-C7.2.O2.query: Follow-up evaluation after changing an AI mentoring, project support or innovation service.

AIQIF-C7.3.F1.assertion: A funding, IP or incubation support route is available to eligible projects.
AIQIF-C7.3.F1.query: Research funding scheme, intellectual property support, incubation programme or enterprise support route for eligible projects.

AIQIF-C7.3.F2.assertion: A contact or application route enables access to that support.
AIQIF-C7.3.F2.query: Funding application process, IP support contact, incubation intake or named project-support access route.

AIQIF-C7.3.A1.assertion: A project record demonstrates use of a funding, IP or incubation support route.
AIQIF-C7.3.A1.query: Project grant use, IP assistance record or incubation engagement documenting actual use of the support route.

AIQIF-C7.3.A2.assertion: A review records a funding or translation decision about an identified project.
AIQIF-C7.3.A2.query: Project review minutes recording a funding, commercialization, intellectual property or translation decision.

AIQIF-C7.3.O1.assertion: A completed review evaluates verified project progression against a stated milestone.
AIQIF-C7.3.O1.query: Completed project progression review comparing verified grant, IP or venture milestones with stated targets.

AIQIF-C7.3.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates the effect of a project-support change.
AIQIF-C7.3.O2.query: Follow-up project evaluation after changing funding, incubation, IP or enterprise support.

AIQIF-C7.4.F1.assertion: A collaboration work plan specifies substantive AI research or application.
AIQIF-C7.4.F1.query: Collaboration work plan or project agreement specifying substantive AI research, development or application activities.

AIQIF-C7.4.F2.assertion: A partner responsibility is assigned for the planned AI work.
AIQIF-C7.4.F2.query: Partner responsibility matrix or assigned work package for the planned AI collaboration.

AIQIF-C7.4.A1.assertion: A delivery record demonstrates substantive AI collaboration beyond an agreement.
AIQIF-C7.4.A1.query: Joint AI project delivery report, implemented output or completed activity beyond signing a memorandum of understanding.

AIQIF-C7.4.A2.assertion: Partner or beneficiary feedback evaluates an identified delivered contribution.
AIQIF-C7.4.A2.query: Partner or beneficiary feedback evaluating a specific delivered AI collaboration contribution.

AIQIF-C7.4.O1.assertion: A completed review evaluates knowledge transfer or a beneficiary result against a stated objective.
AIQIF-C7.4.O1.query: Completed review comparing AI knowledge transfer or beneficiary results with the collaboration objective.

AIQIF-C7.4.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates the effect of a collaboration change.
AIQIF-C7.4.O2.query: Follow-up collaboration evaluation after changing partner roles, delivery arrangements or project design.

AIQIF-C8.1.F1.assertion: An institutional digital service has a defined purpose.
AIQIF-C8.1.F1.query: Institutional digital service catalogue, service description or process document defining its intended purpose.

AIQIF-C8.1.F2.assertion: A responsible owner is assigned to that service.
AIQIF-C8.1.F2.query: Service owner register, appointment order or accountable department for the institutional digital service.

AIQIF-C8.1.A1.assertion: Operational records demonstrate repeated AI use in an identified institutional service.
AIQIF-C8.1.A1.query: Operational logs, service transactions or repeated workflow records demonstrating actual AI use in an institutional service.

AIQIF-C8.1.A2.assertion: A monitoring record evaluates an AI-related service exception.
AIQIF-C8.1.A2.query: AI service exception log, monitoring alert, error review and recorded disposition.

AIQIF-C8.1.O1.assertion: A completed evaluation compares service benefit with a stated baseline while disclosing quality limitations.
AIQIF-C8.1.O1.query: Completed AI service evaluation comparing measured benefit with a baseline and disclosing quality or interpretation limitations.

AIQIF-C8.1.O2.assertion: A follow-up tests the effect of a workflow or control change.
AIQIF-C8.1.O2.query: Follow-up workflow or control test after changing an AI-enabled institutional service.

AIQIF-C8.2.F1.assertion: An industry work plan specifies an AI-related activity.
AIQIF-C8.2.F1.query: Industry partnership work plan specifying an artificial intelligence training, curriculum, project or applied activity.

AIQIF-C8.2.F2.assertion: The activity defines a contribution to skills, curriculum or projects.
AIQIF-C8.2.F2.query: Industry activity plan identifying the intended contribution to learner skills, curriculum content or project work.

AIQIF-C8.2.A1.assertion: A delivery record demonstrates an AI-related activity with an industry partner.
AIQIF-C8.2.A1.query: Joint AI workshop, industry project, curriculum activity or delivery report naming the industry partner and actual delivery.

AIQIF-C8.2.A2.assertion: A review evaluates the partner's delivered contribution to skills, projects or opportunities.
AIQIF-C8.2.A2.query: Review of an industry partner contribution using delivered skills activities, projects or student opportunities.

AIQIF-C8.2.O1.assertion: A completed partnership review evaluates a relevant output or outcome against a stated objective.
AIQIF-C8.2.O1.query: Completed industry partnership review comparing measured outputs or outcomes with a stated partnership objective.

AIQIF-C8.2.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates the effect of a jointly agreed delivery change.
AIQIF-C8.2.O2.query: Follow-up review of a jointly agreed change to industry partnership delivery.

AIQIF-C8.3.F1.assertion: An employment, enterprise or workforce pathway explicitly addresses AI skills.
AIQIF-C8.3.F1.query: Employment, entrepreneurship, enterprise or workforce development pathway explicitly identifying AI-related skills.

AIQIF-C8.3.F2.assertion: An opportunity or referral route connects eligible participants to the pathway.
AIQIF-C8.3.F2.query: AI workforce opportunity notice, referral process, eligibility rules or access route connecting participants to the pathway.

AIQIF-C8.3.A1.assertion: A verified record links an AI pathway participant to an opportunity or venture.
AIQIF-C8.3.A1.query: Verified employer, venture or opportunity record linking a participant to an AI skills pathway.

AIQIF-C8.3.A2.assertion: A review examines the relationship between pathway participation and an observed result.
AIQIF-C8.3.A2.query: Pathway review connecting recorded participation with an observed employment, enterprise or workforce result.

AIQIF-C8.3.O1.assertion: A completed review evaluates a verified progression or enterprise result against a stated objective.
AIQIF-C8.3.O1.query: Completed review comparing verified career progression or enterprise results with the pathway objective.

AIQIF-C8.3.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates the effect of a pathway portfolio change.
AIQIF-C8.3.O2.query: Follow-up evaluation after changing an AI employment, enterprise or workforce pathway portfolio.

AIQIF-C8.4.F1.assertion: An identified AI intervention has an explicit intended outcome.
AIQIF-C8.4.F1.query: AI intervention proposal, project charter or implementation plan explicitly naming the intended educational or business outcome.

AIQIF-C8.4.F2.assertion: A prospective measurement method is defined for that outcome.
AIQIF-C8.4.F2.query: Prospective AI outcome measurement plan specifying baseline, metric, collection method and comparison procedure.

AIQIF-C8.4.A1.assertion: Recorded results compare an AI intervention's outcome with a stated baseline using a disclosed method.
AIQIF-C8.4.A1.query: AI intervention results report with baseline comparison, measured outcome and disclosed evaluation method.

AIQIF-C8.4.A2.assertion: A review examines an alternative explanation or potential harm affecting interpretation.
AIQIF-C8.4.A2.query: Outcome review discussing confounding factors, alternative explanations, unintended harms or attribution limitations.

AIQIF-C8.4.O1.assertion: A completed measurement review evaluates benefit within explicitly stated limitations.
AIQIF-C8.4.O1.query: Completed measurement review evaluating AI intervention benefit while stating uncertainty and limitations.

AIQIF-C8.4.O2.assertion: A subsequent measurement evaluates the effect of an intervention change.
AIQIF-C8.4.O2.query: Subsequent outcome measurement after changing the AI intervention, using a disclosed comparison method.

AIQIF-C9.1.F1.assertion: An institutional review process uses defined indicators.
AIQIF-C9.1.F1.query: IQAC review, academic audit, AQAR, accreditation or institutional quality process specifying indicators and measures.

AIQIF-C9.1.F2.assertion: Responsibility for producing the indicator-based review is assigned.
AIQIF-C9.1.F2.query: IQAC coordinator, audit committee or quality assurance responsibility order assigning production of an indicator-based institutional review.

AIQIF-C9.1.A1.assertion: A repeated institutional assessment uses traceable evidence with reproducible calculations.
AIQIF-C9.1.A1.query: Repeated institutional quality assessment with source records, indicator calculations and reproducible totals.

AIQIF-C9.1.A2.assertion: A change record distinguishes institutional evidence changes from methodology changes.
AIQIF-C9.1.A2.query: Assessment change log separating revised source evidence or institutional circumstances from revised calculation rules or methodology.

AIQIF-C9.1.O1.assertion: A completed review evaluates an improvement priority using the assessment's results.
AIQIF-C9.1.O1.query: Completed institutional review using assessment findings to evaluate a specific improvement priority.

AIQIF-C9.1.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates the effect of a measurement-method revision.
AIQIF-C9.1.O2.query: Follow-up evaluation after revising an institutional measurement or assessment method.

AIQIF-C9.2.F1.assertion: An evidence index identifies the source records used for assessment.
AIQIF-C9.2.F1.query: Evidence index, accreditation source register, document repository catalogue or annexure list linking assessment evidence to source records.

AIQIF-C9.2.F2.assertion: A custodian is assigned to preserve those records.
AIQIF-C9.2.F2.query: Evidence custodian, records officer or responsible unit assigned preservation of assessment source documents.

AIQIF-C9.2.A1.assertion: A sampled assessment finding is traceable to its requirement and source passage.
AIQIF-C9.2.A1.query: Sampled assessment finding linked to its indicator or requirement and the exact supporting document passage.

AIQIF-C9.2.A2.assertion: An evidence correction preserves the earlier record and reason for change.
AIQIF-C9.2.A2.query: Evidence correction log preserving the prior record, replacement, author and reason for the change.

AIQIF-C9.2.O1.assertion: A completed audit evaluates traceability against an explicit checking procedure.
AIQIF-C9.2.O1.query: Completed evidence audit applying an explicit source-tracing or verification procedure to assessment findings.

AIQIF-C9.2.O2.assertion: A follow-up measures the effect of an evidence-process improvement.
AIQIF-C9.2.O2.query: Follow-up measurement of evidence availability, source tracing or audit quality after improving the evidence process.

AIQIF-C9.3.F1.assertion: A process monitors relevant accreditation, curriculum or technology changes.
AIQIF-C9.3.F1.query: IQAC, academic council or technology review process monitoring accreditation guidance, curriculum regulations or relevant technology changes.

AIQIF-C9.3.F2.assertion: A review schedule defines when those changes are considered.
AIQIF-C9.3.F2.query: Accreditation, curriculum or technology monitoring calendar defining when external changes are reviewed.

AIQIF-C9.3.A1.assertion: A change review identifies a requirement affected by an external change.
AIQIF-C9.3.A1.query: External change review identifying a specific assessment requirement affected by new guidance, curriculum or technology.

AIQIF-C9.3.A2.assertion: A versioned reassessment preserves the prior result with an explanation of the change.
AIQIF-C9.3.A2.query: Versioned reassessment retaining the previous institutional result and explaining the effect of a changed requirement or method.

AIQIF-C9.3.O1.assertion: A completed review evaluates the timeliness of a detected relevant change.
AIQIF-C9.3.O1.query: Completed monitoring review comparing detection and response dates with a stated timeliness expectation.

AIQIF-C9.3.O2.assertion: A follow-up evaluates the effect of a monitoring-process revision.
AIQIF-C9.3.O2.query: Follow-up evaluation after revising accreditation, curriculum or technology change monitoring.

AIQIF-C9.4.F1.assertion: A feedback process covers an institutional digital or learning initiative.
AIQIF-C9.4.F1.query: Feedback collection or review process for an institutional digital service, teaching initiative or learning programme.

AIQIF-C9.4.F2.assertion: A follow-up register assigns ownership of resulting actions.
AIQIF-C9.4.F2.query: Feedback action-taken register assigning owners and follow-up responsibilities for identified improvements.

AIQIF-C9.4.A1.assertion: A user acceptance or outcome review evaluates an identified deployed initiative.
AIQIF-C9.4.A1.query: User acceptance testing, service feedback or outcome review of a named deployed institutional initiative.

AIQIF-C9.4.A2.assertion: A corrective action has a recorded completion check.
AIQIF-C9.4.A2.query: Corrective action record containing a completion check or verification of the implemented response.

AIQIF-C9.4.O1.assertion: A completed review evaluates the subsequent result of a feedback-driven change.
AIQIF-C9.4.O1.query: Completed follow-up review evaluating results after a feedback-driven institutional change.

AIQIF-C9.4.O2.assertion: A later initiative demonstrably applies a lesson from that review.
AIQIF-C9.4.O2.query: Later initiative or project record showing application of a specific lesson from an earlier feedback or outcome review.
